title: Show that no positive entry inside this arc zeros both far directions
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 arc `{0,1}`, one direction of every far pair has a numerator independent of the off-diagonal parameter: `-9/512`, `-1/512`, or `-9/512`. Both directions therefore never vanish together.
- The other directions vanish at `0` or `1`. At `x=1` the surviving directions are `-1/64` and `-1/576`, the bandwidth stays 4, and the row gap rises to `11/8`. Either diagonal vanishes a pair only at `-1/8`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
